response.rationale: The hallmark is third-degree AV block on 24-hour monitoring with syncope and exertional dyspnea in an elderly patient. Progression from bifascicular block and first-degree AV block strongly supports primary degenerative conduction disease (D1) over alternative causes. D2 (ischemic) is plausible given hypertension but lacks evidence of infarction. D3 (sarcoidosis) is unlikely at age 80 with no systemic features. D4 and D5 are improbable due to lack of medication history and overt AV block, respectively.
